svg.title: Figure 4.3: The point model at the R22D-16 lowering
svg.desc: The point model of branch Q at the R22D-16 case: a patch of Q's caps as the 600-cell complex, the cells of the target, of Bad(W) and of V⁻¹(Bad(W)), with their chambers counted by home cell (111 each), the five label points of a cell, and how the commutator's letters move the points
svg.text: Figure 4.3: The point model at the R22D-16 lowering
Q = branch 1 · 120 caps · 2,641 cells × 5 labels = 13,205 points
caps of Bad(W) cells, W = C⁶
Patch: 43 caps, 187 adjacency edges; all neighbours of the marked cells, with every edge among them.
One cell's five label points: [18, 84, 110] · content of 42 pieces
The content's point, first letter first
W = C⁶ · |Bad(W)| = 111 home chambers · C⁶ is not the identity on all 13,205 points (50 moved).
V = (287, 3) is a SAFE letter of branch 0, outside Q. V⁻¹(Bad(W)) has 111 chambers, all holes at Y: the exact replay of V·W·V⁻¹
from all home chambers takes off exactly these.
Committed research evidence · provisional colours · no Windows/DirectX or performance claim
